notes: The constructor mints the entire fixed 1e27-unit supply to the deployer. The launch factory handles the 10% swarm allocation, 90% pool seed and any remainder. Transfers from the Ethereum Uniswap v4 PoolManager pay a fixed 2% tax, rounded down to minor units, to 0xD30eA9E0FA0C671BB4dC6C6e83863396B1822951; all transfers to the manager and ordinary wallet transfers are untaxed. No owner, admin, minting, burning or upgrade functions exist. The supplied initialPrice is provenance only; the factory derives the opening price from the economics and deployed currency order.
